headline: Gold drops over 2% as interest rate and oil concerns depress sentiment
summary: Gold bullion fell over 2% on Thursday, hitting its lowest price level since August. Market declines were driven by persistent interest rate concerns and crude oil price movements.
why: Gold is a primary global commodity asset traded as a hedge against inflation and financial market volatility.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Elevated interest rate prospects diminish investor demand for non-yielding bullion assets.

why_moved: Elevated yields and rate expectations led investors to sell gold positions.
